budget_note: 10 ms per merge: the background compactor runs off the write path and is triggered every 100 ms, so one merge may take at most a tenth of that
rule: U <= B accept | L > B reject | else insufficient-evidence
diff_convention: diff = B(subprocess) - A(in-process), ns per merge; positive means the subprocess path costs more

bootstrap.method: percentile bootstrap of the paired mean difference

cases.rule: U<=B accept; L>B reject; otherwise insufficient-evidence
